title: Waterpark, amusement park, compound like restaurant/bar, haunted house, ski resort, museum, malls, aquarium, thrift stores, hotel, exotic space resorts?
content: I have been visiting many locations in my dreams. I don’t know if they are all in the same world-Sometimes I am traveling by a train but unlike any train in this reality. Other times by car, but I don’t think I can reach the water park and what not by car, but I can reach the aquarium and the thrift store. The thrift store is in the middle of nowhere in a desert like place and has lots of Halloween costumes. The aquarium has lots of glass structures you can walk under to see the animals. Somewhere near the aquarium there is a beach and boardwalk. There’s a massive book store right off the boardwalk. There are often tidal waves that come to that area. I’ve stayed at tall condos that have crashed because of the storms. I remember accessing the water park and the amusement park getting off some sort of transit systems which connects to sky tunnels that connects to the parks. The security is hefty I’ve gotten turned away before. The water park is very elaborate and otherworldly, it has gotten scary before when people were getting stuck on the slides. There is an arcade connected to the water park. There is also a ski area connected to the water park. The amusement park is kind of like Disney world and there’s lots of gift stores. I remember a ride like splash mountain. There’s also a museum which has a lot of interactive exhibits with a haunted house in its basement. The compound restaurant is a huge warehouse that is semi connected to outside. There’s bars, breakfast restaurants, at night it turns into a nightclub. There’s individual businesses though. But it’s huge and there’s many rooms at night versus the one big warehouse. The exotic space resort is really hard to describe. It’s got these weird tunnel things with membrane like protrusions, kind of like it’s made of coral. There’s also pools and hot tubs all within it. It feels alien like so that’s why i say space and Ive also experienced really intense vertical travel that feels like space travel. The hotel is huge and has these giant elevators that go really fast and knock people over. You can also go up by stairs but it’s very convoluted and feels evil. I don’t remember ever being in the rooms, but I’ve been underneath and through secret tunnels. There are government like officials underneath, and the tunnels connect to the train like station. It’s really confusing to get onto the train, there’s many connections you have to make through a system of slides. The mall has a lot, I always remember a forever 21 like store but everything is in the middle of the store, and the around the clothes there’s just empty space in the room. There’s also a fancy dress store. There’s also a pet store in the mall, with a lot of fish. Within my dreams, I’m also traveling to really super futuristic cities, like an elevated Times Square. It feels like it’s not in America. Somewhere there is a very steep hill, almost like a pyramid made of stairs and dirt. Sometimes I’m traveling over these places aerially, like flying but really fast. Sometimes I can hover over and land. Also not sure if connected, but I dream of these huge water ways. I am sometimes in the water, diving, and I see huge sharks, whales, alligators. I recently just had a dream of an underwater hotel, the view in the room was of manatees swimming right outside the window. My dreams include a lot more detail than what I can remember and also verbalize, but this is the gist.
